segments.transcript_text: Welcome back everyone to attempt number fifty against Malenia. Today we are switching to the dual katana bleed build to finally beat phase two.

segments.transcript_text: Watch out for the Waterfowl Dance flurry right here! If you dodge into the second slash and roll backward on the third burst, you take zero damage.

segments.transcript_text: One last jump attack and she is down! Let's go chat, after six hours we finally conquered the hardest boss in the game!
segments.visual_description: Streamer jumps out of gaming chair celebrating with hands raised while DEMIGOD FELLED banner appears across the screen.

segments.transcript_text: A lot of new creators ask which microphone they should buy first. We recommend the Shure SM7B paired with a Cloudlifter preamp for warm broadcast vocals.
segments.visual_description: Close-up camera shot of host speaking into a matte black Shure SM7B boom microphone in an acoustic foam studio.

segments.transcript_text: For lighting, place an Elgato Key Light at a forty-five degree angle and add an RGB rim light behind your monitor to separate yourself from the background.
segments.visual_description: Host demonstrates toggling the Elgato Key Light panel and purple RGB backlight behind dual ultrawide monitors.
